scorecard.subtitle: Scored against the five workstreams the sprint carried, not against raw ticket completion
scorecard.bannerText: Studies  ·  Security  ·  Prefect  ·  News & Announcements  ·  Human Relevance
scorecard.bottomLine: Three studies closed out and the August hotfix is live in Production. The Critical Prefect blocker finally cleared, so the migrations, the News page and Human Relevance carry with momentum, but 14 tickets now sit in review.

goals.title: Close out the September study releases
goals.detail: COTC026, COTC030, PRECINCT02 and the COTC021 Low Pass WGS load closed. Three COTC021/022 v.3 tickets remain in close-out.

goals.title: Get the August Invicti remediation to Production
goals.detail: Hotfix live in Production Sep 16. Interop GraphQL fix in review (SLA Oct 16); new High Tomcat CVE Ready for QA (SLA Oct 14).

goals.title: Advance the Jenkins to Prefect migration
goals.detail: Critical worker permissions closed Oct 5 after five sprints; all three job migrations moved to Ready for Review. Bucket and Jenkins teardown In Progress.

goals.title: Ship the updated News and Announcements pages
goals.detail: Backend queries closed Sep 14; Homepage Announcements closed Oct 5. News page build and Publications design are in review.

goals.title: Human Relevance and C3DC interoperability
goals.detail: ICDC to C3DC interop requirements closed Oct 1. MVP prototype design in review with Hannah; investigator review In Progress with Gina.

points.title: Tasks carried the sprint: 13 of 32 (41%)
points.detail: Eight were study-release close-outs. The rest: Prefect worker permissions, the Production hotfix deploy, a GraphQL introspection fix, the Announcements backend queries and the C3DC requirements.

points.title: User stories: 2 of 4 closed
points.detail: Study-page query error handling and the Homepage Announcements section. DMN example-file sync is in review; the 2022 DMN sidebar story is still unassigned.

points.title: Bugs: 1 of 2 closed
points.detail: The Critical file download bug (HTML returned instead of the file) closed Oct 5. View in Browser opening a blank page is in review with Eric.

team.shoutout: Ambar Rana built 6 of the 16 closed tickets: the COTC026, COTC030, PRECINCT02 and COTC021 Low Pass WGS loads, the PRECINCT02 submission review and the /v1/graphql introspection fix. Philip Musk ran the study close-out and closed 8. Charles Ngu landed the Prefect permissions and the Production hotfix. Toyo Udosen shipped the Announcements backend and Homepage section.
team.whyDisagree: The Assignee on a closed ICDC ticket is whoever moved it to Closed: this sprint that was mostly Philip (study close-out) and Valentina (QA). Credit comes from the Developer field (customfield_23650); coordination work such as resubmissions and IndexD carries no Developer by design. Counts are as of Oct 9, so they include four tickets closed after Sprint 52 opened.

carry.bigNote: Fourteen of them are already waiting on review.

facts.title: 14 of 23 in Ready for Review
facts.detail: Three Prefect migrations, three security items, three study close-outs, plus News page, Publications design, DMN example files, View in Browser and the C3DC prototype.

facts.title: Two security SLAs next week
facts.detail: ICDC-4250 Tomcat CVE (High) due Oct 14, Ready for QA. ICDC-4213 interop GraphQL introspection (Medium) due Oct 16, in review.

facts.title: ICDC-4172 is finally closed
facts.detail: Critical Prefect worker permissions closed Oct 5 after five sprints; the three migrations it gated are now in review.

risks.title: Two security SLAs land Oct 14 and Oct 16
risks.detail: ICDC-4250 (High, Tomcat 10.1.59) is Ready for QA; ICDC-4213 (Medium, interop GraphQL introspection) is Ready for Review. Both still need Stage and Production deploys through a ServiceNow change request.
risks.nextStep: confirm today who finishes QA on 4250 and review on 4213, and book the Production change request before Oct 14.

risks.title: Review queue: 14 of 23 carry-overs are in Ready for Review
risks.detail: Review and QA throughput has been flagged before. The queue now holds the Prefect trio, three security items and three study close-outs, so Sprint 52 delivery depends on it clearing.
risks.nextStep: decide today: name a review owner per track and a target to clear the Prefect and security items by Oct 14.

risks.title: Sprint 52 is 68% inherited
risks.detail: 23 of its 34 tickets carried from Sprint 51, leaving little room for new work such as the Human Relevance C3DC display story (ICDC-4244, 8 pts).
risks.nextStep: at Sprint 52 midpoint, confirm what new work still fits, and pull ICDC-2808 (2022, unassigned) from the sprint.

risks.title: Prefect cutover still has open dependencies
risks.detail: Lower-tier Prefect bucket (4192) and Jenkins AppServer teardown (4180) are In Progress; the MEVAL bucket policy (4187) is On Hold.
risks.nextStep: Eric and Charles to give a cutover date for the three migrations once review clears.

retro.timingNote: Sprint 52 started October 1 and is more than a week in. Action items from today either get inserted into the sprint already in flight, or deferred to Sprint 53 planning. Decide which as we assign each one.
retro.liked: The Prefect permissions blocker finally cleared, three studies closed out and the August hotfix reached Production. Say what made those go well.
retro.lacked: Fourteen tickets are waiting on review and two security SLAs land next week. Name the real cause.
retro.learned: Anything about the Prefect permissions path, the study close-out, or how a security fix moves from scan to Production.
